usedFor: Shopify holds products and orders, and Dotdigital starts a new list for them through “Create a List”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product” in Shopify, then “Create a List” in Dotdigital
bestTemplate.why: Each new product gets its own list in Dotdigital, ready for the people who buy it.

watchOut: “Order Line Items Are Edited” fires on every edit, so “Create a List” could run twice for one order.
